dialogue.tycoonrogue.greeting.picky.1: Hmph. Let's see if this place is any good.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.greeting.picky.2: I hope the quality here is acceptable.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.greeting.chatty.1: Oh hi! Lovely weather, isn't it? Anyway, listen!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.greeting.chatty.2: Hey hey! I've heard so much about this place!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.greeting.generous.1: What a wonderful place! I'm in a spending mood!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.greeting.generous.2: Hello, friend! I'm happy to pay well today.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.thanks.shy.2: That was... really nice of you.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.thanks.picky.2: Not bad. I might come back.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.thanks.chatty.1: Wow, thanks! I'm telling everyone about this!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.thanks.chatty.2: Amazing! Wait till I post about this!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.scared.picky.1: This is outrageous! I'll never shop here again!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.scared.chatty.1: Help! Somebody! Everyone's gonna hear about this!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.scared.chatty.2: Hands up?! I'm telling the whole town!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.scared.generous.1: Take it easy! I'll pay whatever, just don't!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.scared.generous.2: Calm down, friend! No need for that!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.complain.shy.1: Um... I think that's the wrong one...
dialogue.tycoonrogue.complain.picky.1: Are you blind? That's not what I asked for!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.complain.chatty.1: Haha, nope, not that one! I need exactly what I said!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.complain.chatty.2: Oh dear, mixed up the order, did you?
dialogue.tycoonrogue.complain.generous.1: No worries, but that's not quite it!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.complain.generous.2: Nice try, friend, but I need the other thing!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.order.plain.1: I'm looking for %2$s of %1$s. Can you supply them?
dialogue.tycoonrogue.order.plain.3: My shop is out of %1$s. %2$s should do it.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.gossip.plain.1: Did you hear? Someone pulled a gun on a customer at that factory!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.gossip.plain.2: I heard the owner scares customers. I'm staying away.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.gossip.plain.3: Rumor has it there's trouble at that factory...
dialogue.tycoonrogue.robber_reveal.plain: Hand it over! This was a robbery all along!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.scammer_reveal.plai: Haha, sucker! Thanks for the free goods!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.raider_charge.plain: Nobody move! This is a robbery!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.raider_flee.plain.2: Fall back! We got the loot!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.inspect.plain.1: Let me take a look around...
dialogue.tycoonrogue.inspect.plain.3: So this is where it all happens.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.rating_high.picky.1: I rarely say this, but well done.
Wow wow wow! I'm telling EVERYONE about this place!
Best factory ever! Posting right now!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.rating_high.generou: You deserve more than I can give!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.rating_low.plain.1: Hmm... a bit small, isn't it?
dialogue.tycoonrogue.rating_low.chatty.1: Oh dear, I have to tell people this isn't great...
dialogue.tycoonrogue.rating_low.chatty.2: Not what I heard! Gonna post about it!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.rating_low.generous: Needs work, but I believe in you!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.streamer.plain.1: Hi chat! Today we visit a factory!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.streamer.plain.2: Smash that like button and look at these machines!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.streamer.plain.3: This will be a banger of a video.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.color_talk.plain.1: My favorite color is %s. Show me some!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.belt_watch.plain.1: Look at those goods rolling by on the belt!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.belt_watch.plain.2: I could watch this belt all day.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.wheel_look.plain.3: I'd love to take it for a spin.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.rocket_look.plain.1: A rocket engine! Please stand back...
dialogue.tycoonrogue.rocket_look.plain.3: That thrust could lift a whole plane.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.stop_idle.plain.2: A machine that stands still makes no money.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.browse.plain.3: I've been looking for something like this!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.browse_buy.plain.3: Can I buy this? Let me pay.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.checkout.plain.1: Excuse me, could you ring this up?
dialogue.tycoonrogue.checkout.plain.2: Hello? I'd like to pay for this.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.checkout.plain.3: Over here, I'm ready to pay!
dialogue.tycoonrogue.flow_good.plain.2: A factory that never stops. I like it.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.flow_bad.plain.1: It seems to have stopped producing...
dialogue.tycoonrogue.flow_bad.plain.2: Where are the goods coming out?
dialogue.tycoonrogue.propeller_look.plai: That bearing runs smooth. Ready for takeoff.
I can feel the wind from here.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.sail_look.plain.1: Those windmill wings are a fine airframe.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.sail_look.plain.3: Wings like these carry a whole airship.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.engine_look.plain.2: A good engine, a good day.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.engine_look.plain.3: Nice and warm. It is really running.
The burner is lit. The envelope is filling!
A hot air balloon, how lovely.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.taste_history.plain: Did you know some of these machines look like ancient engineering?
I love anything with a story behind it.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.taste_cars.plain.1: A good engine sound makes my day.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.taste_cars.plain.2: Do you build anything with wheels here?
dialogue.tycoonrogue.taste_airplanes.pla: I dream of building a plane someday.
Anything that flies, I want it.
I can't think straight without coffee.
The smell of roasted beans... heaven.
dialogue.tycoonrogue.taste_cola.plain.2: Is there something fizzy around here?

book.tycoonrogue.giwa.1:
GIWA ROOFS

A hanok roof is covered in curved clay tiles (giwa): concave female tiles and convex male tiles, ending in decorated round end tiles. Two common shapes: gable (matbae) and hip-and-gable (paljak).
book.tycoonrogue.giwa.2:
IN MINECRAFT

Use dark roof blocks: deepslate tile, stone brick or blackstone stairs and slabs. Step each layer one block inward. Let the eaves stick out 1-2 blocks past the wall.
book.tycoonrogue.giwa.3:
THE CURVE

The famous upturned corners (chuyeo) come from raising the four corners one slab higher than the middle of each edge. Put upside-down stairs under the eaves as rafters (seokkaerae). Finish the ridge (yongmaru) with a row of slabs.
book.tycoonrogue.giwa.4:
SCORING

Tile-roof stairs and slabs count: 6 blocks = 1 point, up to 12 points. History lovers need real buildings, not chest items. Buy the Hologram Guide to see a full pavilion.
book.tycoonrogue.dancheong.1:
DANCHEONG

Dancheong is the painted decoration on Korean wooden buildings. It uses five traditional colours (obangsaek): blue, white, red, black and yellow. Green is a common stand-in for the blue family.
book.tycoonrogue.dancheong.2:
PATTERN

Simple gitgi style: paint each beam with a blue or green base, red at both ends, thin white lines between, and a yellow centre. Pillars are plain red.
book.tycoonrogue.dancheong.3:
IN MINECRAFT

Use terracotta: blue, green, red, yellow, white, black. Pillars: stripped crimson stems. Put a beam ring just under the eaves, and brackets (gongpo) of stairs and trapdoors on top of the pillars.
book.tycoonrogue.dancheong.4:
SCORING

Painted-eave blocks count: 5 blocks = 1 point, up to 10 points. Lanterns and bells add up to 3 more. The pavilion hologram uses exactly this pattern.
book.tycoonrogue.flight.1:
FLIGHT GUIDE

Create Aeronautics (with Simulated) turns a structure of blocks into a flying vehicle. This guide follows the public 'Survival Plane MK1' build on createmod.com. Details may change with mod updates.
book.tycoonrogue.flight.2:
BODY AND WINGS

The body and wings are sails: create:white_sail and simulated:white_symmetric_sail. They are light. Add a few levitite blocks (aeronautics) near the middle for lift. Keep the shape symmetric.
book.tycoonrogue.flight.3:
POWER

Put a propeller bearing (aeronautics:propeller_bearing) on the nose. Feed it with Create shafts, cogwheels and gearshifts from portable engines (simulated:red_portable_engine) behind the seat. A simulated analog transmission lets you adjust propeller speed.
book.tycoonrogue.flight.4:
ASSEMBLE AND FLY

Place a physics assembler (simulated:physics_assembler) against the frame and use it; afterwards it can be removed. Add fuel to the engines, sit in the seat, and right-click the linked typewriter. In Survival Plane MK1: W/S pitch, A/D roll, hold Shift for throttle, Ctrl to brake.
book.tycoonrogue.flight.5:
SCORING

Airplane lovers count a propeller bearing, levitite, sails and engines near the Tycoon Counter, and airplane items in chests. Hold W over any item in JEI to open its Ponder for exact steps.
book.tycoonrogue.car.1:
CAR GUIDE

Cars use Create Offroad wheel mounts (offroad:wheel_mount) on a frame that Simulated's physics assembler turns into a vehicle. Details may change with mod updates.
book.tycoonrogue.car.2:
CHASSIS

Build a flat frame from Create casings and a linear chassis, with a seat (create:red_seat) in the middle. Keep it wide and low so it does not tip.
book.tycoonrogue.car.3:
WHEELS AND POWER

Place wheel mounts at the four corners and attach the wheels. Power them with Create shafts and cogwheels from portable engines (simulated:red_portable_engine); a gearshift lets you reverse.
book.tycoonrogue.car.4:
ASSEMBLE AND DRIVE

Use the physics assembler on the frame, fuel the engines, sit down and right-click the linked typewriter to take control. Tune speed with an analog transmission.
book.tycoonrogue.car.5:
SCORING

Car lovers count wheel mounts, engines and a physics assembler near the Tycoon Counter, plus car items in chests. Hold W over an item in JEI for its Ponder.
